author: Jordan Ramée
description: I've felt off about Rayman Legends Retold since its announcement. It's a remake of Rayman Legends, the best game in the platforming series, but the original game still holds up surprisingly well 13 years later. I can't help but compare Retold to Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced--another remake of a 13-year-old Ubisoft title--in that neither feel necessary. And having now played Retold for just under three hours, that feeling isn't going away. Retold feels like an excellent framework for what the series should look like going forward, but the original Rayman Legends already established that s
title: Rayman Legends Retold Feels Like A Remake That Didn’t Need To Happen

author: Levi Winslow
description:
As Xbox continues its reset and lays off nearly 300 staff, the company announced that some of its subsidiaries have been shaken up as well. This includes Obsidian Entertainment, which will now operate under Bethesda Softworks.

On September 22, Xbox chief content officer and executive vice president Matt Booty posted on Xbox's website, outlining a new structure that sees the Bethesda business unit now include Obsidian.

"Bethesda will expand its remit to include Obsidian, which will continue its current projects, including Grounded, as well as the new Fallout project made in collaboration with Bethesda Game Studios," Booty wrote on Xbox Wire.
title: Obsidian’s New Fallout Game Is Still Coming, As The Studio Moves Under Bethesda’s Umbrella

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Big changes are afoot at Microsoft, as the company announced a massive reorganization of its Xbox gaming division. While Activision and Bethesda will expand their remit, adding several studios to their portfolio, Forza series developers Playground and Turn 10 won't be included in the consolidation. Instead, the two developers are joining forces, merging into one developer after years of tag-teaming on games like Forza Horizon and Fable.

"These two studios have been creative and franchise partners for over a decade, and today’s changes will formally move their work into one team," Xbox chi
title: Xbox’s Forza Studios Have Been Tag-Teaming For Years. Now They’re Becoming One

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
In the wake of the latest round of reshuffles and retrenchments, Microsoft has confirmed that State of Decay 3 developer, Undead Labs, has reached an agreement with a new publisher that will keep the game alive.

Undead Labs will now continue working on State of Decay 3, with Microsoft confirming that the game will still launch on Xbox Game Pass day-one when its ready. The studio confirmed the news in an announcement of its own, confirming that it is now a completely "independent, employee-owned game development studio."

title: State Of Decay 3 Lives On, And Is Still Coming To Game Pass

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Ahead of its release in November, the marketing for Grand Theft Auto 6 has begun to take over Miami's Kaseya Center. As part of the campaign, developer Rockstar Games and publisher Take-Two Interactive are decking out the stadium in giant GTA 6 letters that will spell out "Welcome to Vice City" once they're fully installed. It's a big task, and one that requires aerial support, as one chopper has been steadily airlifting them up to their designated spot. Onlookers have been documenting the process and posting clips online of it:
title: GTA 6 Is Taking Over Miami, One Airlifted Letter At A Time

author: Levi Winslow
description:
It's yet another sad day in the games industry as Xbox's continued gutting of its subsidiaries gets worse, with acclaimed action game studio Ninja Theory headed for the chopping block.

Xbox's chief content officer and executive vice president Matt Booty took to the official Xbox website on September 22 to announce that the Hellblade studio will go forward with the proposed closure.

"Unfortunately, two separate agreements for Ninja Theory fell through," Booty wrote. "We will now begin consultation with employees on a proposed closure while continuing to explore other paths forward."

Ninja Theory has developed several games since its founding in March 2000. You might know the studio for
title: Ninja Theory Now Expected To Close As Deal Falls Apart

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft's "reset" of the Xbox business continued today with the announcement of another giant wave of changes and restructuring to help the business become more successful in the future, or at least that's the plan. The major moves included more layoffs, the planned closure of another developer, and a significant shakeup for the Halo franchise, among others.

These major changes were announced just before Microsoft's fiscal Q1 ends on September 30. Here's everything we learned:

Layoffs

To begin with, Xbox boss Matt Booty said there will be a further 268 layoffs that affect Halo Studios, other first-party developers, and the Xbox Game Studios management and central functions team.

This latest round of cuts comes after Microsoft laid off 1,600 Xbox developers in July, including the studios it div
title: All The Major Xbox Changes Microsoft Announced Today: Layoffs, Halo Goes To Activision, And Lots More

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Microsoft has officially announced a major change to its Halo franchise, as Activision will develop the next game in the series with a new, purpose-built team. A small team at Halo Studios will continue to support the Halo community and existing games. The new studio will also exist separately from the group of developers that work on the annual Call of Duty series.

Unfortunately, it's bad news for Halo Studios, as Microsoft has confirmed that it will be impacted by a new wave of layoffs that it had previously announced. In total, 268 people will be laid off across Halo Studios, other Xbox developers, and Xbox Game Studios management. title: Halo’s Next Game Is Coming From An Unexpected Developer: Activision

author: Callum Self
description:
If you put Vampire Survivors into a blender, shoved Stardew Valley in there, added a dash of Plants Vs. Zombies, and then gave it an art style similar to Cult of the Lamb, The Rabbit Haul is exactly what you’d get. This whimsical cozy game by day, tower defense and strategy gem by night, is a brilliant time-waster and an excellent indie that will test your abilities with each passing evening. If that sounds like your type of game, you can already get it at a pretty great price at launch.

Combining elements from some of the best indie games and making them work together is no easy feat. In fact, it’s a hopping difficult one, yet The Rabbit Haul makes it work. title: The Rabbit Haul Blends Cult Of The Lamb, Vampire Survivors, And Plants Vs. Zombies, And This Indie Already Has A Big Launch Deal

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Control Resonant is a huge game in general, but in terms of Remedy's games, it's certainly the biggest one the studio has ever made. Set in a zone-based semi-open-world version of Manhattan, it's a huge action game with RPG-like depth in its combat build system. It's also full of main and side missions that will take you dozens of hours to complete in total. Here's how long it'll take you to beat Control Resonant.

How long to beat Control Resonant depending on your play style

If played on the standard difficulty and playing some of the side missions, but perhaps not all of them, you're likely in for something like 30-35 hours of gameplay in Control Resonant. title: How Long Is Control Resonant – Mission List And Hours Played

description:
